choices: Preserve all35 source1 anvil material/durability identities and full two-workpiece surface, side split/odd remainder return, hammer storage/display,3 exact hit-dependent recipe maps, atomic empty-workpiece recipe markers, output rolls, fatigue/haste-aware overflow-safe wear, break scrap, insertion-only sided capability and persisted work/durability. Native block drops preserve durability with an identified BLOCK_ENTITY_DATA component; workpieces drop separately. Complete material and foreign-item workpiece rendering is connected. Variant catalogue, workpiece geometry, strike/wear and recipe costs are consumed by Forge and NeoForge, with platform-specific ItemStack/registry/NBT boundaries.

Adopt masson powered-context fallback to top anvil mode for a bottom strike. Its AnvilStrikeContext itself returns empty for DOWN, while AutomaticHammerBlockEntity.anvilMode() falls back to ANVIL. The shared powered flag preserves rejection of ordinary DOWN hits and prevents the source1 automatic hammer from throwing Anvil face. Preserve source1 full two side bending maps; brokestar explicitly folds them into one map and registers only Stone/Blackstone here, so that implementation would reduce existing scope. Full native AnvilRecipeDefinitions/AnvilForgingRecipes are now registered in the main recipe loader; all21 self-forging recipes use a single shared catalogue.

Port all7 mortar/grindstone/sifter variants, material pestle tint, genuine held-item grinding/10-click progress, installed abrasive counters, cursed/GT-tool/enchanted-book exclusions and XP-bearing vanilla disenchantment,12 sifter output slots, operator look/distance/haste/fatigue gating, retrieval and inventory/progress persistence. Shared work limits/timing/abrasives/exhaustion are used on both platforms. Native enchantments use holder tags and data components, preserving the original applicability rules.

Port all7 bowl/table/juicer/steel and wooden bathing-pot variants, finite4k/8k tanks and1M juicer output capacity, source1 full32-GU recipe transactions/capacity-before-consumption, rain collection, fluid hazard/material-temperature gates, plunger/container interaction and item/fluid displayed contents rendering. Native tanks/inventory use explicit registry providers. Shared identities/capacities/rain/fill/power/exhaustion rules are consumed on both platforms. brokestar kitchen source explicitly crops rain/tools/visual pool and approximates SIMPLE by non-gaseous fluid; source1 provides those actual paths. masson mixing bowl and bathing runtime have richer dedicated sided layouts/transactions and progress semantics, retained as pending comparison/replacement work rather than imported as a second processing engine.

Port60 material scaffolds with four actual designs, dynamic sneaking collision, loaded world support traversal, drop and ladder behavior;6 material ropes with wall/hanging placement and downward extension; crank potion-dependent signed RU packets plus independent redstone pulse;1-slot dust funnel atomic accepted material insertion into the existing native crucible; universal top-face plant pot;8000mB sap bag with adjacent loaded tree-hole collection and hand container output; full advanced button pulse/switch/lamp modes, tool configuration, inversion/strength, persistent live state and packed item configuration. Utility identities/packet/timing/design/dust/button wrap rules are shared. All6 ropes now explicitly expose ladder behavior on both platforms; the previous source minecraft climbable tag only named the base rope.

Preserve the single material/registry/energy/crucible contracts. masson dust funnel is a36-unit dust denomination ledger with top input/bottom output into handlers, while source1 funnel feeds the crucible directly and also accepts dustDiv72. It is not a drop-in behavioral replacement and remains a later integrated alternate variant, not a silently discarded donor. brokestar crank also explicitly crops its upstream player targeting/villager arms and uses an engine-drive testing window; keep actual source1 gameplay pulse/packet and record the continuous-crank gap.
knownGaps: Grouped dual compile PASS:49 manual/vessel blocks39s, all120 blocks27s. One ordinary native dedicated startup follows; no new subsystem fixture or per-module startup was added.

Actual powered hammer-anvil interaction, survival availability/craft recipes, manual recipe outputs/conservation, curses/XP/abrasive exhaustion, renderer/contents orientation and all client behavior remain unverified. Powered anvil quality is not applied as an additional recipe gate in baseline. The grindstone disenchantment branch retains the baseline behavior of not decrementing abrasives; no unsupported upstream equivalence claimed.

Baseline vessel drain capability includes input tanks as well as output tanks; brokestar output-only drain/rotating tank and masson explicit sided layouts may be stronger policies. Preserve baseline initially; all rain/fluid/juicer transaction behavior and provider/component save migration need gameplay and independent restart evidence.

Sap bag baseline empties the resin hole before proving available bag capacity, and can lose a resin/fluid yield on overflow. No donor fix was established in this wave; explicitly retained defect pending transactional repair. Source sap bag model does not expose an integrated full overlay path in this port. Tank contents deliberately disappear when broken as in the baseline.

Crank is one packet per click and a10-tick redstone pulse; original GT6 continuous targeting/villager driving and animated texture remain absent in baseline/donor. Rope extension/support traversal permissions and chunk-boundary behavior, scaffold support search and advanced button multi-hand behavior remain unverified.

Forge runtime, both clients, complete survival chain, independent-process saved-world restart, old saves and production jars/release remain pending. No license, history or source tree was changed; publication permission remains unresolved. Full integration goal stays active.
